title: Reder Road in Griffith: The Hitchhiker Legend of Northwest Indiana

sources.what: five-mile road once connected Griffith to Merrillville, closed since the 1970s; shadow figure sometimes holding a lantern by the train tracks; Elizabeth Wilson story is the vanishing-hitchhiker kind; no burial records of an Elizabeth Wilson found in Ross Cemetery
sources.who: Ghost Research Society (Dale Kaczmarek), Reder Road Investigation

sources.what: five-mile road between Griffith and Merrillville; yellow barricades; a man in black walking toward you from the tracks at night
legend: Elizabeth Wilson drowned in a swamp when her car went off the road; she waits for a ride and disappears at Ross Cemetery, where she was buried in 1955
legend (per Indiana Haunted Houses): in the 1950s a young woman crashed on Reeder Road and drowned in a nearby swamp; her ghost is seen walking down the road hoping for a ride
Reeder Road, for generations a place with scary stories attached
sources.who: Valpo.Life, 'Three horrifying haunts from around the Region'

sources.what: Reder Rd is a residential street in Griffith (addresses 1000-1860)
Ross Cemetery, 5001 Whitcomb St, Calumet Township, founded 1860

beats.text: A young woman by a dark road, waiting for a ride. This is Reder Road, in Griffith.
beats.label: GRIFFITH, INDIANA

beats.text: It once ran a few miles through the woods toward Merrillville. Today its east end is gated off, and has been for decades.
beats.label: TOWARD MERRILLVILLE
beats.credit: Ghost Research Society; Occult World; Valpo.Life

beats.text: Legend says a young woman named Elizabeth Wilson was in a car that went off the road in the 1950s, into a swamp, and never made it home.
beats.label: THE LEGEND
beats.credit: Legend: Ghost Research Society; WROK; OnlyInYourState

beats.text: People say she still walks the road, looking for a ride. And drivers who stop for her say she vanishes near Ross Cemetery.
beats.label: WHAT PEOPLE SAY
beats.credit: Legend: HauntedPlaces.org; WROK; Ghost Research Society

beats.text: Others report a dark figure walking the railroad tracks nearby, sometimes carrying a lantern.
beats.label: BY THE TRACKS

beats.text: But the Ghost Research Society says it found no burial record for an Elizabeth Wilson at Ross Cemetery.
beats.label: NO RECORD

beats.text: And some say she's still out there, waiting by the road.
beats.label: STILL WAITING

beats.text: Comment your town, and it could be next.

end_card.pill: A neighborhood street: respect residents and gates
